note: Co-operative Bank of Kenya's tariff guide (charges and fees as of 12 May 2025; a poster read by eye): an individual's current account carries an account maintenance fee of 300 shillings a month, before the excise duty the poster says applies to all fees without giving its rate; ledger fees of 35 shillings an entry aren't modelled. Its Hekima savings account carries no maintenance fee but limits counter withdrawals to one every three months.

sources.title: Co-op Bank Tariff Guide (charges and fees as of 12 May 2025)
sources.said: Excise duty will apply to all fees, charges and commisions. ... Charges and Fees are captured as of 12th May 2025. Current Account: Minimum opening balance (cash) Individuals Ksh.5,000; Minimum operating balance Nil; Account maintenance fee Ksh.300 per month; Ledger fees Ksh.35 per entry. (Read by eye from the poster.)
